Helpful, device-first steps

Tivione IPTV Setup Guides

Start with the device you have. If a step is unclear, our WhatsApp support is ready to help.

Firestick

Install your preferred compatible player, then add the server credentials received after activation.

Smart TV

Download a supported TV app such as IBO Player or Smart ONE, then connect with your subscription details.

Android

Install TiviMate, Smarters or XCIPTV, choose the requested login method and enter your supplied information.

iPhone / iPad

Use an App Store-compatible IPTV player and add your details through its playlist or Xtream login screen.

Windows

Install a compatible desktop player, then use the server URL and credentials provided with your service.

MAG & Enigma2

Contact support with your device details so the correct portal or connection setup can be supplied.
